events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: Explore bold and experimental artworks from 21st-century China, featuring mesmerising light installations, powerful video art, and large-scale sculpture from the renowned White Rabbit Collection. This exhibition challenges perceptions of modern China through art.

events.title: Beneath the Surface
events.description: This exhibition explores water as memory, metaphor, and force within the Australian landscape, bringing together painting, photography, and installation to reveal hidden histories and shifting perspectives. It's anchored by the significant work 'The Rainforest'.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Join Aka (grandmother) Lisa Sorbie Martin in an immersive Children's Gallery exhibition sharing her art and Torres Strait culture. The space features vibrant colours, patterns, and interactive elements to learn about the reef and island life.

events.title: Gold Coast: AI Builders Showcase
events.description: An evening showcase presented by Emerging Tech Hub, exploring what local innovators are building with AI on the Gold Coast. This meet-and-demo style event is ideal for curious tech minds and builders.

events.title: The History of Gold Coast Pubs
events.description: A community lecture at Elanora Library delving into the social and cultural history of Gold Coast pubs. This talk explores the heritage of local watering holes, ideal for curious locals interested in history.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Botanical Watercolour Painting
events.description: A nature-inspired watercolour workshop presented by NaturallyGC, connecting art with local plant life. Participants will learn techniques to paint botanical subjects in a creative and relaxed environment.

events.title: Nu Metal Tribute Night: Slipknot, Korn & Limp Bizkit tributes
events.description: Experience a high-energy Nu Metal tribute night featuring THE VIOLENT INZIDENT (Limp Bizkit & Korn tributes) and other acts. Doors open at 6 PM with pre-show food and cocktails available from 5 PM.

events.title: Comedy Underground – Saturday Night Showcase
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise (The Basement)
events.description: Enjoy 90 minutes of side-splitting stand-up comedy with fresh new line-ups every week in HOTA's intimate Basement venue. This is the Gold Coast's dedicated home for top-tier live comedy.

events.title: Gin Blending Class – Cauldron Distillery, Tamborine Mountain
events.description: An informative and interactive one-hour gin blending class where you'll learn about gin and craft your own custom bottle using individually distilled botanicals, guided by expert distillers. Perfect for a creative outing.

events.title: Women's Introductory Mountain Bike Course
events.description: The second session of a beginner-friendly, women-only introductory mountain bike course. This event offers a great opportunity to connect with like-minded outdoorsy people and develop new skills.

events.title: Anthea Polson Art – Gallery Visits
events.description: Visit Anthea Polson Art, an established Gold Coast contemporary gallery in the charming Tedder Avenue precinct. A great opportunity to drop in and explore current exhibitions.

events.title: Lorraine Pilgrim Gallery & Gallery One
events.description: Explore two accessible local art galleries in Southport, Lorraine Pilgrim Gallery and Gallery One. Both are open for walk-in visits this week, offering diverse contemporary art viewing experiences.

events.title: Sundown Sessions at Koi Broadbeach
events.description: Enjoy relaxed afternoons with live music, drinks, and grazing at Koi in Broadbeach. These recurring sessions offer a perfect setting for casual conversation and good company to ease into the evening.
